nodes.name: NF pretreatment
nodes.procedure: The nickel foam with a size of 2 × 3 cm² was immersed in a 3 M HCl solution under sonication for 15 min to remove the surface oxides. The treated nickel foam was washed with ultrapure water and ethanol alternatively, and then dried under vacuum at 60°C.

nodes.name: NiFe/NF variants electrodeposition
nodes.procedure: A mixture of 0.075 M NiSO₄, 0.025 M FeSO₄, 0.2 M H₃BO₃, and 2 M NH₄Cl was prepared as plating solution and deposited on nickel foam for 150 s at current densities of 1, 2, or 3 A cm⁻² using the two-electrode system, labeled Ni₀.₇₅Fe₀.₂₅/NF-1A, Ni₀.₇₅Fe₀.₂₅/NF, and Ni₀.₇₅Fe₀.₂₅/NF-3A, respectively. Also, the deposition was carried out at a current density of 2 A cm⁻² for 120 s or 180 s, labeled as Ni₀.₇₅Fe₀.₂₅/NF-120 s, Ni₀.₇₅Fe₀.₂₅/NF-180 s, respectively.

nodes.evidence_snippet: the as-deposited Ni_{0.75}Fe_{0.25} material on the NF substrate exhibited a cauliflower-like surface with array-shaped tunnel structure (Fig. 1b-e and Figure S5). The average diameter of the regular tunnels is approximately 10 μm.

nodes.characterization_summary: Water contact angle test shows superhydrophilic behavior: droplet completely spreads on Ni_{0.75}Fe_{0.25}/NF surface in 10 ms (NF shows no apparent wetting).
nodes.evidence_snippet: As depicted in Fig. 2a-b and Video S1, there is no apparent wetting of water on the NF surface. For comparison, the droplet can completely spread on the surface of Ni_{0.75}Fe_{0.25}/NF sample in 10 ms.

nodes.characterization_summary: Underwater bubble contact angles measured by trapped bubble method: 114° for NF and 150° for Ni_{0.75}Fe_{0.25}/NF (superaerophobic property).
nodes.evidence_snippet: the contact angles were found to be 114° for NF and 150° for Ni_{0.75}Fe_{0.25}/NF samples, respectively (Fig. 2c-d).

nodes.characterization_summary: Bubble adhesion force is approximately 70 μN for NF with noticeable bubble deformation, while no substantial adhesion force detected for Ni_{0.75}Fe_{0.25}/NF with minimal deformation.
nodes.evidence_snippet: a significant change in adhesion force, approximately 70 μN, was observed for NF... In contrast, no substantial bubble adhesion force is detected for Ni_{0.75}Fe_{0.25}/NF.
